title: Riviera Healthcare Center
description: Riviera Healthcare Center is a for-profit skilled nursing facility in operation for over 50 years. It provides 24-hour nursing and rehabilitation services. Due to negligence and poor security practices, confidential data was exposed, including patient protected health information (PHI)names, diagnoses, medical histories, fall/fracture and treatment information, payment records, and employee/HR data. This breach violates HIPAA and the California CMIA (and potentially the CCPA/CPRA) and will result in mandatory breach notification, federal and state fines, civil lawsuits, corrective action plans, and significant reputational and financial damage.
